props.gloss_en: Ulla's surface memra: once a piggul handful was brought to the altar its piggul status departed
first rejected reading: Ulla merely teaches that eating the handful incurs no piggul liability
second rejected reading: Ulla teaches that a piggul item which ascended does not descend
third rejected reading: Ulla teaches that a piggul item which descended ascends again
operative reading: if altar fire took hold of any of the handful before it descended, the whole handful is returned
the mishna: one is not liable for eating the handful under the piggul prohibition
the mishna already states that disqualified items which ascended do not descend
the mishna's general rule: disqualified items that descended do not ascend again
Rav Achai: even when only half was on the altar and caught fire, the whole handful is brought up
